message:
This PR updates the project structure documentation in `/webchat/data/chatbotreadme.md` to accurately reflect the intended file organization.

## Changes Made

- **Updated master protocol reference**: Changed `SYSTEM_DIAGNOSTIC.md` to `MARMREADME.md` to match the correct filename
- **Removed outdated entries**: Eliminated `decision-tree.md` and `README.md` from the project structure tree
- **Fixed tree formatting**: Updated the final entry to use proper tree structure formatting (`└──` for the last item)

## Before
```
├── data/
│   ├── SYSTEM_DIAGNOSTIC.md  # Master protocol
│   ├── HANDBOOK.md           # User guide
│   ├── FAQ.md                # FAQ
│   ├── DESCRIPTION.md        # Protocol overview (+ audio link)
│   └── decision-tree.md      # (Optional: logic tree/notes)
├── media/
│   └── media_MARM_Audio_Walkthrough.mp3 # Audio walkthrough
├── style.css                 # Minimalist CSS
├── README.md                 # This file
```

## After
```
├── data/
│   ├── MARMREADME.md  # Master protocol
│   ├── HANDBOOK.md           # User guide
│   ├── FAQ.md                # FAQ
│   └──  DESCRIPTION.md        # Protocol overview (+ audio link)
├── media/
│   └── media_MARM_Audio_Walkthrough.mp3 # Audio walkthrough
└── style.css                 # Minimalist CSS
```

This ensures the documentation accurately represents the current project structure and provides correct guidance for users working with the MARM Protocol chatbot scaffold.
